stem.text: Solid carbon dioxide, $\text{CO}_2$, is similar to solid iodine, $\text{I}_2$, in its structure and properties. Carbon is in Group 14. Silica, $\text{SiO}_2$, is a Group 14 compound.
Which statement about solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ is correct?

A.text: Both solids exist in a lattice structure.

B.text: Both solids have a simple molecular structure.

C.text: Both solids have atoms joined by single covalent bonds.

D.text: Both solids change spontaneously to gas at s.t.p.
